I bought one bag of DAP and one bag of urea from the cooperative for this plot, which is what I can afford after paying school fees, and I will spread it the way I did last year. My cousin used improved wheat seed and her yield was much better than mine, so I bought two tins of improved seed too, because I know the fertilizer must go with it or the seed is wasted. I will not spray chemicals on wheat — we pull weeds by hand and accept what the weather gives us — and there is no river or pump here for irrigation. I will work this plot with my children for about 50 days over the season, and at harvest I will hire two day-laborers for four days each to help with threshing because my back pains me now.
